rationale: `new Markdown(text, paddingX, paddingY, theme, defaultTextStyle?, options?)` is NewMarkdownWithOptions(content, paddingX, paddingY, theme, style, options), with a pointer for each optional argument; NewMarkdown(content) is a convenience with zero padding and no theme.
Markdown is the Go struct Markdown; every member is mapped individually.

invalidate.rationale: Markdown.invalidate() is Invalidate(): it bumps the revision so the transform and parser rerun on the next render.

render.rationale: Markdown.render is the Go method Markdown.Render; signature reviewed against the upstream declaration; callers and tests attributed by go/types (methodrefs).

setText.rationale: Markdown.setText is the Go method tui.Markdown.SetText; signature reviewed against the upstream declaration. Closed as public-api-tested: the method is exported from the public tui package and no PiG binary calls it; test callers (go/types) are the proof.
